punchline: Surgeons added a 19-item list read aloud, and in eight hospitals major complications fell from 11 to 7 percent.
thirty_sec: Inspired by aviation, a World Health Organization team wrote a 19-item surgical checklist. Patient identity, surgical site, antibiotics and the instrument count were all confirmed aloud. In eight hospitals, 3,733 patients were followed before the list and 3,955 after. Major complications fell from 11 to 7 percent. Atul Gawande tells it in The Checklist Manifesto.
